thread:
Mica: heads-up — after enabling speculative prefetch on redwood-14b-quant in canary we see regen-rate spike (~3x) on long-form testset. p95 latency dropped 10%, but repeat tokens and hallucination-like repeats increased.

Raj: any config changes besides prefetch? temp/sampling params?

Mica: nothing else. sampling kept at top_p=0.9 temp=0.8. batch sizing changed to 16 for canary. Model quantized to 4-bit.

Elle: can you paste the quick script you used for the onboarding eval?

Mica: sure
```bash
rwictl eval run \
  --model redwood-14b-4bit \
  --decoding speculative_prefetch \
  --batch 16 \
  --sampling-config '{"temp":0.8,"top_p":0.9}' \
  --evalset longform_holdout_1k \
  --metrics regen_rate,perplexity,bleu
```

Raj: logs?

Mica: pasted snippet from logs:
```
[2026-03-18T15:12:03Z] regen_rate: baseline 0.07 -> canary 0.22
[2026-03-18T15:12:30Z] ppl: baseline 12.3 -> canary 12.7
[2026-03-18T15:12:45Z] p95 latency: baseline 420ms -> canary 380ms
```

Elle: so small ppl regress but big regen. Could be prefetch causing stale KV reuse or sampling amplification when prefix is overlapped.

Tomas: check if prefix caching is enabled with speculative prefetch. If it's reusing old KV windows we might be amplifying n-gram loops.

Mica: confirmed prefix_caching=true with overlap=256 tokens. Can try overlap=64.

Raj: quick A/B plan: (1) rollback prefetch on dedicated canary, (2) run holdout with overlap=64, (3) run a deterministic beam baseline to measure true quality gap.

Elle: + add regen-rate broken down by ngram length (1,2,3). If we're seeing unigram loops that's different from coherent repetition.

Mica: will run tests now. Running two jobs: a) overlap=64, b) overlap=0 (no prefetch). ETA ~30m.

SRE Bot: Job 93721 queued and scheduled on canary-gpu-pool.

Tomas: also capture logits variance over time — higher variance might indicate sampling instability post-quantization.

Mica: noted. will upload results to /evals/triage/1735556789 and ping when done.

Raj: sounds good. If overlap reduction fixes regen without killing latency win, we'll ship config tweak. If not, rollback prefetch by EOD.

Elle: thanks team :thumbsup:
